description: SN4 naming lint config (AlembicCore). SN4a codified scripts/configs/docs kebab + tests ClassName.test.ts. SN4 (0.3.0 RW3) UN-PARKS the src scope now that SD-5 phase-2 removed the src-covering wildcard exports: src modules are camelCase or PascalCase (no kebab/snake) by SN0 §1 export-shape; the drizzle migrations NNN_snake family is the FIRST src rule (first-match-wins) and stays EXEMPT. Exceptions require {file, owner, reason}; entries missing a field do not exempt.

rules.label: tests are ClassName.test.ts (PascalCase stem) under test/
drizzle migrations are NNN_snake_case.ts — DELIBERATE exempt artifact family (SN0 §1), never rename
src modules are camelCase or PascalCase (no kebab/snake)

exceptions.reason: Named after its unit module src/shared/resolveProjectRoot.ts, a camelCase utility that stays camelCase permanently (SN0 §1 utilities row); Pascal-casing the test would break the named-after-unit principle (SN4a census judgment).
